name: Supplemental irrigation

soft_risks.risk: Irrigation raises soil salinity in dryland areas, and without proper drainage salts accumulate in the root zone
soft_risks.mitigation: Provide drainage, apply a leaching fraction, and monitor electrical conductivity each season

soft_risks.risk: Abstraction can draw down a shared groundwater table
soft_risks.mitigation: Pair with rainwater harvesting and use drip delivery to cut total demand

mechanism: Adding water when rainfall falls short lifts the moisture constraint on growth, at the cost of importing dissolved salts that stay behind as water evaporates.
